contracts.evaluator: 0x5132a0 clears three DWORD globals 0x92224c,0x922250,0x922254, then always calls full parser 0x4f88e0 with resolver 0x513230. It does not use the runtime numeric shortcut: 1+2 and (1+2) both return 3, and an empty string returns 1 via terminator factor. After parsing, nonzero 0x922250 sets 0x922254 to 1. Value is stored float32 before return. Mutable lexer behavior is inherited unchanged from the shared parser.
contracts.resolver: Each 0x513230 symbol sets SeenSymbol=1 and LastSymbolUnresolved=1. Optional game callback 0x9238c0 receives NULL creature and packet, symbol text, and an initially-zero output float. Nonzero callback return clears LastSymbolUnresolved. Unlike runtime 0x514850, a false callback retains any float it wrote: there is no parameter fallback or reserved Rand/true/false/max handling. RNG and runtime creature/packet globals stay unchanged.
contracts.lastSymbol: LastSymbolUnresolved is overwritten on every symbol. The final flag therefore reflects the LAST resolved/looked-ahead symbol, rather than whether any symbol was unresolved. With only known handled, missing+known clears RequiresRuntime, while known+missing sets it. The portable code preserves this original rule; it does not fix or reinterpret it.
contracts.outputs: Resolver always returns 0 and writes optional float and/or low-32-bits of signed-64 truncation using native 0x6e6b90 behavior. Direct resolver calls preserve the preexisting RequiresRuntime global. All optional-pointer combinations and finite values around signed-32/signed-64 boundaries are compared, including false callback return with a written value.
contracts.caller: Condition loader 0x52b3f0 first checks parameter bindings and its constant table. Its fallback at decompiled/corpus-expanded/FUN_52b3f0.c:184 calls 0x5132a0 and stores the result at condition+8. Nonzero 0x922254 sets condition flags bit8, stores an expression index at+0xd, and retains a copied expression pointer at+0x10. This caller relationship is static original-PC evidence; the full tokenizer, allocator and loader body are not newly ported or claimed dynamically validated here.
contracts.verification: 422 original-PC comparisons pass: 180 expression/context cases,128 generated arithmetic/symbol cases and114 direct optional-output cases. All 40 resolver instructions and all 16 wrapper instructions execute in the fixture set. Native comparison includes result bits, classification flags, symbol/error call order, changed text, RNG and runtime pointer globals. The optional game callback is the sole substituted producer. Portable core and replay compile; execution is pending under the explicit compile-only instruction.

Direct resolver cases exercise optional outputs and callback false-with-value behavior.
